AI agent workflows

Skills

I built a collection of reusable skills for Codex and Claude that help teams go from source material to work they can review and use.

Independent project

The problem

Product work involves recurring tasks with different source material each time. A short prompt can leave the output format and review steps open to interpretation.

The decision

I documented the input, the steps and the expected output for each skill. For example, Spec to Backlog creates editable stories with acceptance criteria and source references. Feedback to Eval turns complaints into cases you can run against multiple versions of an assistant.

What you can try

Browse the catalog to find a skill for your work. You can also try the Document Review Lab to check simulated extraction against the original lines in a sample document.
